# Ledco Plumbing

> Ledco Plumbing is a plumber in Seminole, Oklahoma. It handles drain cleaning, water heater repair and installation, leak detection, sewer line repair and commercial plumbing for homes and businesses in Seminole and Wewoka, OK. The company is owned by Mickey Ledbetter and is open seven days a week.

Last updated: 2026-10-19

## Business Information

- Business name: Ledco Plumbing
- Business type: Plumber (residential and commercial plumbing contractor)
- Owner: Mickey Ledbetter
- Address: 316 E Oak Ave, Seminole, OK 74868
- Phone: (405) 257-3096
- Hours: Monday through Sunday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM
- Website: https://preview-ledco-plumbing.pageone.cloud/
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.google.com/maps?cid=10062941840203095213
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=place_id:ChIJy6bf-8yIs4cRrZy4tEnApos

## Services

- [Drain Cleaning](https://preview-ledco-plumbing.pageone.cloud/services/drain-cleaning/): Kitchen, bath, laundry and main line clogs cleared for homes and businesses in Seminole, OK.
- [Water Heater Repair & Installation](https://preview-ledco-plumbing.pageone.cloud/services/water-heater-repair-installation/): Diagnosis and repair of water heaters that run cold or leak, and new water heater installation.
- [Leak Detection & Repair](https://preview-ledco-plumbing.pageone.cloud/services/leak-detection-repair/): Tracing high water bills and hidden leaks in walls, slabs and yard lines, then repairing the pipe.
- [Sewer Line Repair](https://preview-ledco-plumbing.pageone.cloud/services/sewer-line-repair/): Repair of backed-up, cracked and root-filled sewer lines in Seminole and Wewoka.
- [Commercial Plumbing](https://preview-ledco-plumbing.pageone.cloud/services/commercial-plumbing/): Restroom, drain, water heater, leak and sewer line work for local businesses.
